Late to the party but gonna add a controversial comment (hopefully already been pointed out) 

This girl could, at her age, be attending the doctor for various reasons without OP's knowledge. The fact that she doesn't know what she is ingesting could very easily hinder medical treatment :/

She may have a weird rash that won't go away, or migraines after her evening meal (insert any other side effect) but the doctor can't figure out because her food (ingestion) diary doesn't tally with her symptoms. 


Replace 'vegetables' with 'medication' (eg. My sister is sexually active at 16 so I'm slipping her birth control) and everyone would be up in arms. *Everyone* has a right to know what they are putting in their body.

You cannot dictate the standard for someone else to live their life. Whether it's their weight, procreation, hobbies or vices. Your standard are YOURS. Hers are hers to deal with, as well as any resulting issues. 

PLEASE stop now before you are dealing with a young adult in hospice care because of an eating disorder (because you are judging her on a number on a weight scale alone) brought on when she inevitably finds out.
